name: Colorado PCB Assembly
old_description: Welcome to Colorado PCB ASSEMBLY: Your #1 PROTOTYPING and PCB Assembly Services Provider
about:
Colorado PCB Assembly operates from Centennial, Colorado, in the Denver Tech Center. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but describes itself as having decades of experience in quick-turn prototyping and assembly.

The shop provides end-to-end PCB assembly services including quick-turn assembly (as fast as one day), turnkey component sourcing, low-volume production, and PCB fabrication through U.S.-based partners. Assembly is performed on automated pick-and-place machines with capabilities for SMT, through-hole, and BGA packages, supported by X-ray inspection, automated optical inspection, in-circuit testing, and functional testing. Typical orders range from a single board to a few hundred units, with a common range of 10–50 pieces.

Customers span telecommunications, LED lighting, automotive, medical, and consumer electronics sectors. The company cites PANTHERTEC, a wearable sensor developer, as a featured client, and has collaborated on high-profile projects such as a William Osman YouTube build. It targets circuit designers and engineering firms needing prototypes or low-volume runs that larger EMS providers often decline.

Colorado PCB Assembly emphasizes personalized service, assigning a dedicated team to each build so the same contact follows the project from inventory through final test. It highlights U.S.-based assembly for shorter shipping lead times and intellectual property control, and adherence to ISO 9001:2015 and J-STD-001 standards.

name: Colorado Threads
old_description: While we have made a lot of progress since 2014, we are still working to do better for you and the planet.
about:
Colorado Threads was founded in 2014 in Lakewood, Colorado, as a private company committed to sustainable activewear. The business began with a mission to keep plastic out of landfills and oceans by transforming recycled water bottles into yoga pants and other apparel. It operates as a Certified B Corporation, reflecting a commitment to social and environmental performance.

The company designs and manufactures activewear including yoga pants, tanks, joggers, hats, and accessories at its boutique manufacturing facility and design studio in Denver. All production is kept local, with materials sourced within a 1,500-mile radius. Since its founding, the brand has expanded to serve customers in 23 countries.

Colorado Threads serves the activewear and outdoor recreation markets, selling directly to consumers through its online store and shipping to 23 countries. Its products are worn by yoga practitioners, hikers, and fitness enthusiasts, with specific collections such as the Red Rocks concert series and Mountain Vista yoga pants.

The company differentiates itself through its Certified B Corporation status, which encompasses three impact business models: supporting local suppliers and economy within a 1,500-mile radius; employing sustainable practices such as using recycled water bottles for fabrics, recycling waste into accessories, and upcycling garments; and investing a portion of revenue into local nonprofits and youth programs to uplift underrepresented communities.

name: Columbia Electric Supply
old_description: Manufacturing innovation and technology have never moved faster, and finding answers to today's challenges can be difficult. With a local teammate bringing solutions and products right to your door, you can find the answers you need to help you reach your goals and succeed.
about:
Columbia Electric Supply, operating as CES Boise, is based in Boise, Idaho. The company serves as a local industrial automation distributor and integrated solutions partner for manufacturers across the Intermountain West.

The firm supplies hardware, software, and services to digitize and connect manufacturing data, processes, and people. Its product portfolio includes motor control systems such as the Rockwell Automation M100, voltage verification devices like Grace Technologies ChekVolt, and the FactoryXT smart manufacturing platform. CES Boise also provides solution consultants, network infrastructure, asset management, and cybersecurity services to keep facilities operating safely and efficiently.

Customers span water and wastewater treatment, food and beverage processing, timber, and energy sectors. The company works with plant managers, engineers, and operations teams who need to modernize legacy systems, improve network visibility, or deploy predictive maintenance.

CES Boise positions itself as an integrated partner that combines local presence with access to global automation brands, emphasizing a consultative approach that addresses both immediate project details and long-term digital transformation goals.

name: Columbus Machine Works
about:
Columbus Machine Works operates from Columbus, Ohio, where it was founded in 1997 by Mike Stacey. Stacey, who holds a Bachelor of Science in Industrial Design, began as a job-shop machinist commuting by bicycle to serve local customers. His deep-rooted passion for machinery and manufacturing grew the business into a central Ohio hub for machining, metalwork, and craftsmanship.

The shop provides a full range of machining and fabrication services, including CNC milling (up to 84" x 32" x 30"), CNC turning (up to 20" diameter x 48" long), wire EDM, conventional machining, gear cutting, grinding, welding (TIG, MIG, stick, spray), and structural fabrication. The facility spans two buildings housing more than 30 CNC lathes and mills, multiple manual machines, presses, EDM, welding stations, and a dedicated inspection room. Services also cover reverse engineering, on-site evaluation, inventory stocking, pickup and delivery, and 24/7 emergency breakdown response.

While the company serves a broad base of local manufacturers, its listed industry focus includes medical equipment. Customers range from small shops needing prototype parts to larger operations requiring OEM replacement components, jigs, fixtures, and repair of shafts, gears, and bearings.

Columbus Machine Works positions itself as a cost-effective alternative to factory replacement parts, emphasizing competitive pricing, lead times, and a one-stop-shop model. The founder's original vision — blending traditional craftsmanship with modern machining — remains the stated differentiator, supported by capabilities like emergency service, inventory management, and on-site support.

name: Comfortfoods Co-packing & Processing
old_description: For over 30 years our goal has been to provide our customers with high quality, delicious tasting, healthy ingredients and custom blends. Whether you bring us your formulation, we develop a custom proprietary formulation just for you or you use one of our fantastic house recipes, we can blend, package, label it in a variety of bags, bottles, or pouches that meet your needs.
about:
Comfort Foods Co-packing & Processing operates from a 44,000-square-foot facility in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The company has been in business for over 30 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. No founder names or ownership structure such as family, veteran, or woman-owned are mentioned in available materials.

The operation provides custom blending, packaging, and co-packing services for both wet and dry food products. Its lines handle package sizes ranging from less than half an ounce up to 50-pound bulk containers. Wet capabilities include salsas, barbecue sauces, jellies, salad dressings, and condiments; dry capabilities cover seasoning blends, soup mixes, bread mixes, dip mixes, and dessert mixes. Packaging formats span bulk, plastic and glass bottles, pouches and packets, portion cups, and cartons. The company also offers custom formulation and private-label manufacturing.

Customers include brands seeking contract manufacturing for shelf-stable condiments, seasoning blends, and packaged meal components. The firm works with clients who bring their own formulations, request proprietary development, or select from the company's house recipes. Its membership in the Contract Manufacturers Association underscores a focus on business-to-business co-packing relationships.

Quality assurance is a stated differentiator: the facility maintains SQF certification with a Costco addendum, HACCP plans, a dedicated allergen program, FDA compliance, kosher certification, metal detection, and sample retention. A full-time quality control staff enforces specifications and good manufacturing practices.

about:
Commercial Apparel, Inc. was founded in 1977 in Winfield, Missouri, initially producing baseball caps. The company is now owned by PicTheGift and operates from Troy, Missouri, with production facilities in Wentzville and St. Louis.

The company provides full-service sewing, precision laser cutting, and large-format dye-sublimation printing up to 74 inches wide. It produces customizable cut-and-sew items such as baby crib sheets, changing pad covers, and pajama pants, with no order minimums or setup charges. Sewing capabilities include elastic incorporation, cover stitch, single stitch, serging, backstitch, and buttonholes.

Commercial Apparel serves the apparel, baby products, and promotional product markets, offering print-on-demand and contract sewing services for brands and retailers seeking custom textile goods. Its customer base includes businesses needing end-to-end production from fabric printing to finished sewn goods.

The company emphasizes its partnership with PicTheGift, enabling vivid, long-lasting sublimation prints with attractive pricing and quick turnaround, and it differentiates itself by imposing no order minimums or setup fees.

Commercial Equipment Service Inc. has operated from Wilmington, Delaware since its founding in 1984. The company provides commercial refrigeration, HVAC, and restaurant equipment services across the region, including the nearby communities of Edgemoor and Elsmere.

The business focuses on repair, installation, and sales of commercial appliances. Its technicians handle refrigeration systems, cooking equipment, and HVAC units for commercial kitchens and facilities. Primary customers are restaurants and other commercial facilities that rely on refrigeration, cooking, and climate-control systems. The company serves independent eateries, institutional kitchens, and property managers throughout New Castle County.

The firm emphasizes quality workmanship and customer service as its defining traits, positioning itself as a long-standing local specialist for HVACR and cooking equipment in Delaware.

name: Commercial Packaging
old_description: Tear- and puncture-resistant woven polypropylene (WPP) is ideal for retail packaging.
about:
Commercial Packaging was founded in 1983 by Gary and Janette Egbers in Bloomington, Illinois. After Gary’s passing in 2004, Janette Egbers continued as chairwoman, president, and CEO, and the company remains family-owned and operated from its Central Illinois headquarters.

The company supplies woven polypropylene bags, flexible intermediate bulk containers (FIBC), multiwall bags, flexible packaging, and stock pouches. It also provides package design, technical field service, artwork design, customized supply agreements, and global logistics. Commercial Packaging manages a network of manufacturing partnerships in the United States, China, Vietnam, Brazil, Indonesia, India, Thailand, and Mexico, and operates a corporate-owned, ASI-certified warehouse.

Its customers span pet food and animal nutrition, seed and grain, chemical, dairy, food ingredients, diatomaceous earth, and salt and sugar markets. Testimonials cite clients in the global food industry, agriculture, and animal sectors.

Commercial Packaging emphasizes supply chain management that navigates international legal, language, and cultural barriers; technical expertise with product managers for each line; quality oversight through on-site processes in overseas plants; and dedicated customer support with assigned account specialists. The firm also offers vendor-managed inventory, safety stock, and consignment programs to reduce lead times and inventory costs.

about:
Commonwealth Solar operates from Wilmore, Kentucky, where it has built a reputation as a dedicated solar installer serving both commercial and residential customers. While the company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, it positions itself as a locally focused enterprise committed to creating Kentucky jobs and keeping installation crews in-house rather than relying on subcontractors.

The firm specializes in turnkey solar projects of any scale, guiding clients through a five-step process that begins with a utility bill analysis and ends with system commissioning. Its installers follow a nationally recognized Gold-standard certification program, and every installation carries a 30-year independent component warranty. The company emphasizes the use of high-grade equipment designed for maximum lifespan and offers ongoing communication and support for the life of each system.

Commonwealth Solar serves businesses across Kentucky seeking to optimize operational expenditures through solar energy, as well as homeowners pursuing energy independence. Its commercial installation track record has earned it a ninth-place state ranking and 127th nationally among U.S. installers, with a stated goal of reaching the top 200 nationally by 2026.

The company's stated mission centers on honest, transparent, and affordable solar solutions delivered with a personal touch.
